title: Summit Prepayment Application and Line Restoration
content:
A Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage borrower may prepay at any time without penalty. A partial prepayment is applied first to accrued unpaid interest and then to principal. A Summit prepayment is applied only while the loan status is active, draw period expired or due and payable. On plans that credit prepaid amounts back to the line, a portion prepaid while the loan is active is credited back to the line on the same day; after the draw period, on a due-and-payable loan and on plans without a line nothing is restored. Releases of a cancelled Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve and installments under a property charge repayment plan are applied the same way, referencing their originating record.

## Status of the loan

| Loan status on the loan record | Prepayment applied | Line credited back (plans that restore the line) |
|---|---|---|
| Active | yes | yes, on the same day |
| Draw period expired | yes | no |
| Due and payable | yes | no |
| In its rescission period, rescinded, paid in full, liquidated | no | — |

The three statuses in which a prepayment is applied are the complete list.

## The plans

Line restoration applies only on plans whose terms credit prepaid amounts back to the line; the Summit Fixed Lump Sum and the Summit Second Lien have no line, and nothing is restored on them in any status.

## Order of application

Each remittance is applied to accrued unpaid interest first; only what remains goes to principal. No penalty is charged on any part of it.

## Other amounts applied the same way

- A release from a cancelled Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve is applied to the Summit balance in the same order, and the entry refers back to that reserve release.
- An installment under a property charge repayment plan is applied in the same order, and the entry refers back to that installment.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On an active Summit Select Line loan with USD 846.12 of accrued unpaid interest, a hypothetical prepayment of USD 5000.00 is applied USD 846.12 to interest and USD 4153.88 to principal, and on the same day the portion prepaid is credited back to the line. The same remittance on that loan after its draw period has expired is applied in the same order, and nothing is credited back.
